notes.title: The "Demo is coming" and other tidbits Update
notes.content:
Happy New Year!
    Your friendly developer here, for the last update before I start a new full-day job. So there will be other updates, but expect them to come a bit less often. But... also because we have a nice idea on how to evolve the new 3D mode, so expect a lot of good stuff to come in 2021, 2022 and so forth!
	
	In this update, you will find a bit more of the 3D levels, with some fixes too, but they are not fully finished yet. There is no save yet, as it will be part of the big change ;), and no ending for the exact same reason!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883218/20e809066faabb9e2eeb852e3f9eb001dc60a5e4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883218/2833856a03be7e576a4efb239ca8493406de6be9.png[/img]

	Also a new landing page, and MMPG has got his progression twice as fast, as it was clearly too slow before.
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883218/d5bd5396848fb3121083bca0bfb01818af94ec4c.png[/img]

	Finally, the demo is integrated into this build, as something like 95% of the translation support. So the demo will come as soon as it works fine and is validated by Steam, so very soon if I didn't do anything wrong, later otherwise. It's the full game but limited to 10 minutes. The save will be kept with the full version and the achievement unlocked in the full version. This last change includes a kind of security. If an achievement has not been unlocked for some reason, it should become unlocked the next time it's possible when NYAF is started.
	
	Sébastien, my graphics artist, has been on fire lately, so expect to see a lot more of his crazy and wonderful world later on!

	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883218/9f23b9df8469c45a5c6f8c4a618eed56d8e8fd84.png[/img]

	On that, I wish you an excellent year 2021, hopefully a lot better than 2020 for most, and for those who had a good year still that it continues so!
	
	Here it has been a so-so year, but together with Sébastien and our family we have been happy to bring NYAF to where it is now. We haven't had any commercial success yet, so that might be a wish for 2021 :).
	
	On that, time to go off,
	    Alain

notes.title: "Coming Soon" Update 1
notes.content:
Hello,
    Your friendly dev here again. Well, that has been a busy week :), and the next weeks will probably be busy too. I will go back to a QoL update this week, mostly trying to add translations, and also see if I can make a demo.
But the last week has been a parenthesis started the weeks before as a simple experiment when I was resting off the QoL Update 2. A very tiring and very interesting parenthesis, involving also Sébastien for some great new art!

It all started with a limitation... blah blah blah... I will start to be boring :).

So you will find 2 new "Coming soon" modes/games. They are still in the same universe, they are still Hidden Object games, but they are not the same too. And they are in 3D (tadam!)...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883218/075d9b3408dc6b2ba2d843f65f1bb0b6535f7072.png[/img]

Just move around using the mouse (left button and mouse wheel) or with the keyboard too, wasd or the arrows keys. And find the hidden characters shown on top. The difficulty levels are back, but they will not place the character back (yet? ), as the games are already much harder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883218/5e3a9a470417ab1eaf6339db91d40700bad6eeef.png[/img]

They should both work fine, but are missing extra modes yet, and we are open to suggestions about them, and there is no save, no credit and no outro and only one music for each level. It will all come though ;).

I hope that you will like them and have some more fun in Nyaf! If possible we would like to continue on this model for a while, so add some more "coming soon" parts after the others are finalized.

Normally it did not introduce bugs and actually helped to fix one serious (that normally only affected me while testing, but we never know). But if there is anything, just drop a message in the discussion area and I will work on it!

And off I go,
    Alain

notes.title: Quality of Life Update 2 - The big one!
notes.content:
Hello all,
    Your exhausted but still friendly dev here! Together with Sébastien, we updated many aspects of Nyaf so it's much clearer what to do and everything looks nice and shiny!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883218/e5df8421498d90ac63fdeeb1ef1170b275e948f2.png[/img]

When first started, you will be able to select the initial difficulty and to see the tutorial for NYAF.
I added a tutorial for each kind of game, so for all excepted YANYAF, which is basically a simpler NYAF. Finally, they are pages that you can navigate using the mouse buttons, the space bar and backspace or the on-screen buttons. I could not do a good video for any game! So you are spared from listening to my voice! On the other hand, it was an occasion to add 2 fantastic tracks to Nyaf, both from the great Chris Huelsbeck.

[list]
[*]NYAF
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883218/1d7288ec6515924b5301a2e4ca46432005d4841c.png[/img]
[*]MMPG
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883218/f471457e9d002d7defdf7cf176ae7bbaf6be6db0.png[/img]
[*]BJS
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883218/a237b770504a385f8aa7831fdd957ff506e7eac2.png[/img]
[/list]

Of course, BJS is a very simple game, so it's a mini-tutorial. And they won't give any secrets away, you still need to look for them! One important thing of all NYAF is that you cannot break anything without a warning first! So try everything, find the secrets and have fun!

Now it was a lot of work, but there is still a lot of work coming this week to finish something very cool. It's planned for the end of the week, so stay tuned!

Never hesitate to use the discussion for any issue or suggestion, and thank you for all the previous feedbacks. This update is a result of them!

On that, on to another update's preparation (well not tonight),
    Alain

notes.title: First Quality of Life update
notes.content:
Hello,
     Your friendly dev here! Thank so much for everyone that bought the game, and to everyone that give me feedback, some coverage, or both!

Following your feedback, here is the first Quality of Life update:

You rightly noticed that the Gibberish sounds are a bit too much after a while or if you find too many characters quickly. Now you can switch to much shorter and much more normal sounds in the preferences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883218/82ed9525f4f92a1786eed17337453c2b347e3ea7.png[/img]

The dog UI at the left was a bit too simple and left many click on it thinking they were normal hidden character. It has been fixed! And many thanks for the person that gave the suggestion!

You could already rotate the game (in some modes ;) ) using the arrow key, now it is also possible using the right mouse button. Give it a try!

Finally the mode C was making at least 1 person sick. I fully changed the mechanism, it is both better and should not make anyone sick!

A tutorial is coming, for 3 games (YANYAF being basically NYAF with different backgrounds). They will probably be video, that I recorded already, if I can cut them well enough. Otherwise I will find a different solution.

Many thanks again,
    Alain
